addyosmani's interview-me interviews you before it builds anything, to close the gap between what you asked for and what you actually want.

https://skillexplorer.dev/skill/interview-me

Trail of Bits, a security firm, made a skill that reads tarot when your prompt is too vague to act on. It comes with a rule: a good card is never permission to ship, skip a test, or bury a finding.

https://skillexplorer.dev/skill/let-fate-decide
